Developer API

Your agent calls Forsig when it needs human approval.

Illustrative private beta API. Final SDK details may change as early users test real workflows.

Escalate action 
const decision = await forsig.escalate({
  agent: "refund-agent",
  runId: "run_123",
  task: "Approve refund for customer #123",
  risk: "refund_over_limit",
  proposedAction: "Issue $500 refund",
  context: {
    customerTier: "VIP",
    orderValue: 1200,
    reason: "Product failed twice"
  }
});

if (decision.status === "approved") {
  await issueRefund(decision.instruction);
}
Reviewer response 
{
  "status": "edited",
  "instruction": "Offer store credit instead of a cash refund.",
  "reviewer": "support_lead",
  "auditId": "audit_9J2k"
}
